This page lives in a nested route, mounted at the root of a docs-first site. Its code is read from `forge-sdk/src` and its links come from the generated SDK reference, so neither can go stale unnoticed.

## Install the client

```bash
pnpm add @forgecms/client
```

Create the client on the server. A key that reaches a browser bundle is a leaked key.

## Configure the SDK

Every client shares one [`ForgeConfig`](/reference/generated/forge-config) object, frozen by [`defineForgeConfig`](/reference/generated/define-forge-config).

:::code config.ts

```ts
/** Settings shared by every client created in an application. */
export interface ForgeConfig {
  /** Project identifier from the Forge dashboard. */
  projectId: string;
  /** Environment the client talks to. Defaults to `production`. */
  environment?: ForgeEnvironment;
  /**
   * Called before every request, for example to refresh a token.
   * Throwing from this hook aborts the request.
   */
  onRequest?: (path: string) => void | Promise<void>;
}
```

## Create a client

[`createForgeClient`](/reference/generated/create-forge-client) takes the secret key and, optionally, that configuration. Reading a page of entries resolves to a [ForgePage](/reference/generated/forge-page).

```ts
export function createForgeClient(apiKey: string, config: Readonly<ForgeConfig>): ForgeClient;
export function createForgeClient(apiKey: string): ForgeClient;
```
